utterance: Build a secure, testable, and observable SaaS booking platform for sports courts.

frame.desired_outcome: Multi-viewpoint foundation for building a booking SaaS
frame.intent_class_hint: build with architecture, security, test, and observability concerns
frame.notes: Do not collapse into one Capability. Existing catalog can partially cover architecture, security review, test planning, and observability. Full product-delivery Capability may still be missing.

candidates.rationale: Greenfield platform needs system structure and boundaries.
Security is an explicit required viewpoint; review applies as designs/surfaces appear.
Testability is an explicit required viewpoint.
Observability is an explicit required viewpoint.

insufficient_coverage.reason: No Capability currently owns full product delivery management; the catalog covers major engineering viewpoints but not a complete build-agency program manager offer.

clarifying_questions: Should we start with architecture as primary, then security/test/observability passes over that architecture?
